children: Tradition today announced a strategic partnership with Affin Moneybrokers Sdn. Bhd., one of Malaysia's leading interbank money brokers, under which Tradition will provide market data infrastructure, pricing technology and distribution capabilities to support Affin's continued growth in the Malaysian financial markets.

The partnership brings together Tradition's global expertise in market data, pricing technologies and information distribution with AFFIN Moneybrokers' established position in Malaysia's wholesale financial markets. Through the collaboration, Tradition will provide pricing tools, data management capabilities and publication services designed to enhance the creation, management and distribution of market data across foreign exchange, money markets, rates and fixed income products.

Affin Moneybrokers is the growing brokerage business and part of the Affin Group and plays an important role in Malaysia's interbank Foreign Exchange, OTC Derivative, Fixed Income and Money Markets, acting as an intermediary between financial institutions supporting price transparency and market efficiency.

The partnership reflects growing demand across Asia for locally sourced, trusted market data and pricing information. By combining AFFIN's market expertise with Tradition's technology, data engineering and distribution capabilities, the two firms aim to further strengthen the availability and quality of Malaysian market data for domestic and international market participants.

title: Tradition Announces Partnership With Affin Moneybrokers to Support Malaysian Market Data
